items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: that's when Rene and Earl and all of them got together and organized this music master

ctx.x: So anyway we fooled around and we made a number or two but we just didn't like the way, we said it's not going to do anything--I still have one, Strolling After School and several of them we did, but we saw that they weren't going anywhere, and we didn't even try because we were paying for this.

So I had to leave California (inaudible), and that's when Rene and Earl and all of them got together and organized this music master, a recording master or something, that they were going to do it and pay and then peddle the thing. Then they said they were going to make Ernie Fields the leader.
In other words, they produced their own record?
